faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RailTel Civil Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RailTel Civil Engineer recruitment is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/BTech degree in Civil Engineering to be eligible for the Civil Engineer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Civil Engineer post is between 21 years and 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Civil Engineer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Civil Engineer post ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month, with annual increments and applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Civil Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Interview followed by a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Civil Engineer post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Civil Engineer position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of RailTel Corporation of India, www.railtelindia.com.
